items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch, gated-product exposure, rights-dependent monetization, affiliate expansion, advertising, and alert expansion; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, affiliate disclosures, claims, provenance, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Exact decision: keep searchwoot.com private, keep external outreach unsent, retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked, and authorize only existing bounded read-only evidence work. Evidence: compliance is a technical baseline only with 37 pass, 15 fail, and 7 unknown; banner, consent, analytics, privacy, and terms findings remain open. Operations and fleet-doctor sweeps have no results. Revenue covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission that is not site-attributable. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, and any future affiliate or advertising use. This is risk triage, not legal advice or certification.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks are closed and 4 remain open. No task is closable on current evidence. Open tasks are searchwoot-legal-source-rights, searchwoot-data-flow-retention, searchwoot-ga4-consent-evidence, and searchwoot-logs-vendors-incident. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage/display/alerts, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Do not send outreach, enable tracking, expand alerts, change the private gate, or expand monetization.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data is counsel_required and launch-blocked; user alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed; GA4 analytics is evidence_needed; operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed. No item is clear or conditionally launchable on current evidence. Smallest next actions are: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review; produce the repository and deployed data-flow and retention table; capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking or advertising; and produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory identifying counsel-required gaps.

Private-site decision: retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked. Their scaffold or parked state, missing analytics, and failed or unreachable compliance evidence do not support public launch or monetization. Next evidence action for each site is a timestamped site-specific checklist covering reachability, content, disclosures, compliance, analytics, monetization, and an explicit retain-parked or bounded-launch decision. Do not expose or monetize before completion.
